name: Singapore - Marina Bay
note: 2 km square around Marina Bay: CBD, Civic District, Marina Bay Sands, Gardens by the Bay. Roadgen v2, Local Visual DNA, quick-travel points chosen manually from well-known places; not an administrative boundary. Singapore drives on the left; the generator lays lanes right-hand (no left-hand support). Terrain: cleaned DEM cache (logs/singapore/clean_dem.py) — the Terrarium tiles here contain tower roofs; heights are a derived assumption.

pois.note: Gardens by the Bay, Raffles Place and Singapore Flyer points moved 190-220 m to the nearest road the spawn rules accept; Merlion, Esplanade, Fullerton, Helix Bridge and Lau Pa Sat have no such road within 150 m (bridges, short CBD blocks) and were dropped.
